results.Description: Touch target guidance depends on platform and web context
results.Do: Use 44pt on iOS and 48dp on Android; for web use the separate WCAG Target Size rule
results.Don't: Treat one unit or minimum as universal across platforms
results.Code Example Good: iOS 44pt; Android 48dp; Web 24 CSS px plus WCAG exceptions

results.Description: Adjacent touch targets need adequate spacing
Short multi-line headings may use balanced wrapping as a progressive visual heuristic
results.Do: Bound the measure and test natural-wrap fallback across widths fonts and locales
results.Don't: Promise an exact final line or insert blanket nonbreaking spaces or hardcoded br tags
results.Code Example Bad: Heading copy rewritten with forced last-line breaks

results.Description: Screen readers use headings for navigation
results.Don't: Skip heading levels or misuse for styling

results.Description: Return cleanup for subscriptions and timers so effects stay predictable.
Keep React.memo as a measured optimization, not a blanket default.
results.Do: Use React.memo for pure components with stable props and real render cost
results.Don't: Memoize every component or use it as a guess

results.Guideline: Use React Compiler first for memoization
results.Description: React Compiler provides automatic memoization; keep manual memoization only for measured hotspots or unsupported cases.
results.Do: Enable the compiler, then use manual memoization only when profiling proves it helps
results.Don't: Treat useMemo, useCallback, or React.memo as the default first answer
results.Code Good: compiler-backed build plus measured useMemo or useCallback only when needed
